caseno: Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 168 of 2022
lawyer:
Mr. S. M Shahjahan, Senior Advocate instructed by Mr. Aid. Nurul Islam Chowdhury, Advocate-on-Record ----- For the Petitioner 
For the Respondent ----- Not represented
parties:
Sabina Alder Runu ----- Petitioner (in jail hajot)
-Vs-
The State, represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Nararyangoj. ----- Respondent.
full_judgment:
Borhanuddin J. This criminal petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 09.012022 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case Na. 5862 of 2021 arising out of Sessions Case No. 1014 of 2021, GR. Na. 153 of 2018 corresponding to Bander Police Station Case Na. 24 dated 08.03.2018 under table 9(Kha) of section 19(1) of the Madak Drabya Niyantran Ain, 1990. 

 2. The prosecution case, in short, is that one Md. Masud Rana, Sub-Inspector of District Detective Branch, Narayangonj, lodged an ejahar with Bandar Police Station, Narayangonj, on 08.03.2018 at 17:15 hours stating that while on duty alongwith his force got a secret information that some drug traffickers were staying at the 1st floor of the house belongs to one Kamrul Islam situated at Rupali Residential Area under Bandar Police Station, Narayangonj and on the basis of the information they rushed to the place of occurrence at 00:20 hours on 08.03.2018; Accused no.1 opened the door of the house and they entered into the room of the house and found the accused no.2-petitioner sitting on the Cot of the room and also found two bags and two mobile sets in the room; After searching the bags, they found total 49,000 pieces red coloured yaba tablet and cash money of Tk.4,95,500/-; Seizure list was prepared in presence of the witnesses; On interrogation, accused no.1 Alam Sarwardi Rubel identified himself as an Assistant Sub-inspector of Police of Narayangonj Sadar Police Station and stated that he collected the seized yaba from absconding accused Abdur Rahman, Rial and 4/5 other persons and kept the yaba in his house to sell; The accused no.2 disclosed that she came to the place of occurrence for purchasing the said yaba tablets; On the basis of the ejahar, Bandar police Station Case being no.24 dated 08.03.2018 under table 9(Kha) of section 19(1) of the Madak Drabya Niyantran Ain, 1990 has been started. 

 4. After investigation, police submitted charge sheet on 28.03.2019 under table 9(Kha)/25 of section 19(1) of the Madak Drabya Niyantran Ain, 1990. By an order dated 02.12.2019 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case being No.4678 of 2019 the ease was sent for further investigation and after investigation police submitted supplementary charge sheet being no.227 dated 23.07.2020 under table 9(Kha)/25 of sec-tion 19(1) of the Madak Drabya Niyantran Ain, 1990. 

 5. The Chief Judicial Magistrate, Narayangonj took cognizance against the accused-petitioner alongwith other 13 accused persons on 20.09.2020. The accused-petitioner filed an application for bail in the Court of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Narayangonj who after hearing rejected the application for bail vide order dated 28.09.2020. Thereafter, the accused-petitioner filed an application praying for bail in the Court of Sessions Judge, Narayangonj who after hearing the application rejected the same vide order dated 12.10.2020. Then the accused-petitioner filed criminal miscellaneous case under section. 498 of the Code Criminal Procedure before the High Court Division which was registered as Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.20596 of 2019. A Division Bench of the High Court Division issued Rule on 11.03.2019 and upon hearing the parties made the Rule absolute on 21.01.2020 enlarging the accused-petitioner on bail till disposal of the G.R. Case. 

 6. Against the order the State preferred. Criminal Miscellaneous Petition being No.76 of 2020 before the Appellate Division and the Hon'ble Judge-in-Chamber has been pleased to stay the order of the High Court Division vide order dated 23.01.2020. Thereafter the State preferred Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal being No.395 of 2020 and after hearing this Division disposed of the leave petition vide order dated 20.09.2020 with some observation and directed the High Court Division to dis-pose of the criminal miscellaneous case expeditiously. 

 7. Thereafter, the accused-petitioner filed fresh application for bail under section 498 of the Code of Criminal Procedure on new grounds. Upon hearing the accused-petitioner a Division Bench of the High Court Division has been pleased to issue Rule and the case was numbered as Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.5862 of 2021. Upon hearing the parties and perusing the record a Division Bench of the High Court Division discharged the Rule vide judgment and order dated 09.01.2022. 

 14. Considering the provision of section 497 of the Code of Criminal Procedure as well as long custody of the accused-petitioner and also taking into consideration that the case is not ready for trial, we are of the view that the accused-petitioner may be enlarged on bail till disposal of the G.R. Case. 

 15. Accordingly, the leave petition is dis-posed of, The judgment and order dated 09.01.2022 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.5862 of 2021 is set aside. 

 16. Let the accused-petitioner Sabina Alder Runu wife of late Saiful Islam @,) Arif @ Baba Arif be: enlarged on bail to the satisfaction of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Narayangonj, till disposal of the G.R Case No.153 of 2018 corresponding to Bandar Police Station Case No,24 dated 08.03.2018.
